_comment: An MV2 manifest reviewed against the MV3 schema set, so manifest-version-mismatch rejects it (error). Exactly one finding is possible: there is a single manifest_version to disagree with, which is why this check cannot be collapsed with anything. The same value also fails the schema's enum for the key, so mistyped-manifest-value reports it as well (warning) - a separate check with its own remedy.
